title: Red Lentil Dal with Curry Leaves
dish_title: Lentil dishes (dal, lentil salad, lentils du Puy)
summary: Red lentils cooked soft with turmeric, then stirred into coconut oil fried with curry leaves, chilli, onion, garlic and ginger.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Rinse
steps.text: Rinse the lentils in the sieve until the water runs almost clear.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Boil them in the 750 ml water, uncovered, stirring often, 15 min until soft and the water is absorbed; stir in the turmeric and cayenne off the heat.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Heat the coconut oil in the frying pan and fry the curry leaves, chillies and onion over medium heat 5 min until the onion softens; add the garlic and ginger for 1-2 min.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Tip in the lentils with the 60 ml water and salt and simmer 3-4 min, stirring.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with coriander and serve with rice or flatbread.

tips: Stir the lentils often so they do not catch.
Stand back when the curry leaves hit the oil; they spit.
Leave the dried chillies whole for gentle heat.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; add water when reheating. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
